description_en: Provides the API operation for the credential verification service. This operation uses a large language model to detect image tampering, forgery, and image quality issues in submitted credential images
description_zh: 凭证核验服务的API接口。接口可以将传入的凭证图片通过大模型进行图片篡改及伪造检测、图片质量检测
name: CredentialVerifyIntl

parameters.help_en:
The credential type. Valid values:

03: enterprise qualification
04: transaction voucher
parameters.help_zh:
凭证类型：

03：企业资质类
04：交易凭据类
parameters.name: cred_type

parameters.help_en:
The credential name (specified as a numeric code). Valid values:

Codes starting with 03: enterprise qualification
0301: business license issued in the Chinese mainland
Codes starting with 04: transaction voucher
0401: bank statement
0402: payslip
0403: utility bill
0405: credit card statement
0499: other
parameters.help_zh:
凭证名称（取数字代码）：

03开头：企业资质类
0301：中国内地工商营业执照
04开头，交易凭据
0401：银行流水
0402：薪资条
0403：水电账单
0405：信用卡账单
0499：其他
parameters.name: cred_name

parameters.help_en:
The URL of the image.
Specify either ImageUrl or ImageFile
parameters.help_zh:
图片的地址。
ImageUrl和ImageFile任选其中一个
parameters.name: image_url

parameters.help_en:
The image input stream.
Specify either ImageUrl or ImageFile
parameters.help_zh:
图片输入流。
ImageUrl和ImageFile任选其中一个
parameters.name: image_file

parameters.help_en:
The call mode. Valid values:
ANTI_FAKE_CHECK: image quality and tampering detection
parameters.help_zh:
调用模式：
ANTI_FAKE_CHECK：图片质量、篡改检测
parameters.name: product_code

Code.description_en: The return code. A value of 200 indicates success. Other values indicate failure
Code.description_zh: 返回码：200为成功，其他为失败

MaterialInfo.description_en: The additional information in JSON format

Result.description_en:
The risk result. Valid values:

0: Low risk.
1: High risk.
2: Suspicious
Result.description_zh:
风险结果：

0：低风险
1：高风险
2：可疑

RiskTag.description_en:
The risk tags, separated by commas (,). Valid values:

PS: Image has been edited with photo editing software.
SCREEN_PHOTO: Photo taken from a screen.
SCREENSHOT: Screenshot.
ORIGINAL_PHOTO: Non-original image
RiskTag.description_zh:
风险标签，多个标签用半角逗号（,）隔开，包括：

PS：图片PS。
SCREEN_PHOTO：屏幕翻拍。
SCREENSHOT：屏幕截屏。
ORIGINAL_PHOTO：非原始图
